text:
1. **[LMRL Gym: Benchmarks for Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning with Language Models](https://lmrl-gym.github.io/)** — The closest match: benchmarks online and offline RL across multi-turn games and conversations with LLM-simulated humans. **People:** Marwa Abdulhai, Isadora White, Charlie Snell, Charles Sun, Joey Hong, and Yuexiang Zhai (UC Berkeley); Kelvin Xu (Google DeepMind); Sergey Levine (UC Berkeley and Google DeepMind).

[Author affiliations](https://sierra.ai/-/cdn/document?src=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.sanity.io%2Ffiles%2Fca4jck6w%2Fproduction%2F91c12fc38719eae97e812c6d59a37de5de288c75.pdf).
